note: BH-9460: seconds between two tries of a FAILED pinned wrangler install (bin/harness-sync.sh's wrangler-install step). Each try downloads wrangler into a fresh stage cache, so a failure that repeats must not download on every 5-minute sync. A change of HARNESS_SYNC_WRANGLER_SPEC tries again at once. Read by wr_install_retry_s in bin/lib/wrangler-run.sh as ${HARNESS_SYNC_WRANGLER_INSTALL_RETRY_S:-}, then this settings row, falling back to WRANGLER_INSTALL_RETRY_S_DEFAULT (3600). 0 is a 0-second window: every sync tries again. A non-number falls through to the default.
